pr_title: changefeedccl: fix race on kafka startup
pr_body:
Wait for kafka to be available after starting it
before creating the changefeed.

Fixes: #131570

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/131612)
